crossCheck.house: All 430 Wikipedia-called voting seats outside LA-2 matched Ballotpedia (state pages and/or call timeline) on winner and party: 0 mismatches. LA-2 (Troy Carter, won outright in the Nov 3 primary) matched the Ballotpedia primary result. 92 seats (CA 52, FL 27, NC 13) also matched official state results. Party totals (D 258 / R 173 incl. TN-4 and NC-10 leaders) match Ballotpedia. Delegates AS, DC, GU, MP, VI matched Ballotpedia.
crossCheck.senate: All 35 races (33 regular + FL and OH specials) matched Ballotpedia; FL and NC also matched official state results. Composition 54 D, 2 I, 44 R matches Ballotpedia (56-44 Democratic caucus).
